title: UNC knocks off previously undefeated No. 25 Pitt while notching first ranked win of Bill Belichick era

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: UNC knocks off previously undefeated No. 25 Pitt while notching first ranked win of Bill Belichick era
sources.description: The Tar Heels erased a 10-0 deficit, and their game-winning touchdown came on a 75-yard catch and run early in the fourth quarter.
